SuiteName: J.A.N.E.T. - Joint Administration and Network Execution Toolkit

Tools.Name: WorkstationPatchingTool
Tools.Description: MECM-driven workstation patching. Bulk scan and patch via RunspacePool, MECM app management (install/uninstall/reinstall/repair), Deploy-Application.ps1 package push, KB scanning and installation, application updaters (M365, Defender, Chrome, Edge), remote messaging, reboot scheduling. CSV export for all results. (Themed v47 with Purple+Gold UI, TCP reachability, WSMan timeouts.)

Tools.Name: ACAS Nemesis Tool
Tools.Description: ACAS-driven vulnerability remediation. Per-vulnerability Updater cards with profile dropdowns (M365 Force/User-Visible, Chrome, Edge, Defender) + per-card Verify button. KB Installer with MECM (CIM targeted) / UsoClient method dropdown. Daily Runs CSV on the shared log share with closing-notes dialog and SIM-style AD displayName + EDIPI operator identity.

Tools.Name: STIG_Tool
Tools.Description: PowerSTIG-backed DSC compliance. Evaluate, review, apply, and verify STIG baselines against Windows 10/11 clients, Server 2019/2022, Windows Firewall, and Defender Antivirus. Per-rule skip lists, dry-run preview, System Restore point before apply, XLSX and CKL (STIG Viewer) exports.

Tools.Name: ReportsTool
Tools.Description: ACAS and patch reporting. Import ACAS CSV or .nessus scan files, cross-reference patch logs, scan-to-scan delta, severity dashboard, per-host summary, batch triage, CSV export. Weekly Export: monthly ACAS_Calculations workbook split into per-week NIPR / SIPR cards with Total Vulns, AR % with/without PMO, MAJCOM score, VPH by category (UEs / Servers / Infrastructure / Printers / PMO with owner roll-up); polished HTML report for presentations. Dirty 30 Triage: ingest Tenable Top 30 Worst Hosts (paste from PDF viewer, CSV, or TXT) and fan through AD bulk lookup to surface squadron, last AD logon, stale detection, and last interactive user.

Tools.Name: RemotePackageInstaller
Tools.Description: Remote software deployment. Push Deploy-Application.ps1 packages OR raw MSI bundles to workstations via UNC share copy and Invoke-Command. MSI bundle mode auto-selects every .msi in the chosen folder and fans them out via msiexec. Package root auto-discovery, credential management, parallel execution, progress tracking, retry failed targets, structured audit logging, and result export.

Tools.Name: RemoteMessageTool
Tools.Description: Remote mass messaging. Send MessageBox popups to logged-in users across workstations in parallel over WinRM. Ping-all reachability check, per-job timeout with mid-send cancel, case-insensitive target dedup, and Pingable/Delivered/Undelivered XLSX export (pure .NET, no Excel dependency).

Tools.Name: SecureBootEnabler
Tools.Description: Remote Secure Boot enablement. Deploy BIOS configuration payloads to Dell, HP, and Lenovo machines via CIM/DCOM scheduled tasks (SYSTEM context, no WinRM dependency). Up to 50 concurrent targets, dry-run mode, per-machine result polling, and CSV export.

Tools.Name: ADSearchTool
Tools.Description: Active Directory search without RSAT. Query users, computers, groups, org boxes, email addresses, and manager chains via raw LDAP. Bulk computer lookup (200+ machines with batched queries and location/squadron parsing), base-users export with privileged vs. standard account separation, and CSV export.

Tools.Name: DHCPScopeOptionTool
Tools.Description: DHCP scope option editor. WinForms GUI for IP-array options (006 DNS, 003 Router, 042 NTP, 044 WINS) on a remote Windows DHCP server via PSSession. Loads all IPv4 scopes, auto-loads current values, in-memory reorder (Up/Down/Top/Bottom) with pre-commit diff confirmation, and bulk-apply footer (append/prepend/remove across every checked scope) for DR-DNS rollouts. 'Use current session' credential bypass for Kerberos/NTLM, per-session log file.

Tools.Name: RemoteRestartScheduler
Tools.Description: Mass scheduled restart with staggered dispatch and pre-restart user warnings. Distributes restarts across a configurable window (default 4000 machines over 60 min starting 02:00 AM) and fires shutdown.exe /m \\HOST /r /t SECONDS per machine so Windows shows a countdown popup before each host reboots. Burst mode (default): every command is fan-out submitted to the pool ASAP with a per-host /t computed at submit time as time-until-that-host's-restart, so 4000 machines dispatch in ~1-2 min and the restart stagger is preserved by Windows itself. Targets paste/CSV import with case-insensitive dedup; side-by-side Exception List (never-restart) with separate CSV import and cross-session persistence to JanetLocal\Remote_Restart\<user>\exceptions.txt. Compute Schedule preview grid + Save Plan CSV, Dry-Run mode, RunspacePool dispatch (1-256 threads, default 96), Cancel Pending, Abort Already-Dispatched (shutdown /a fan-out), Results CSV export. v1.3.0 adds a pop-out Reboot Verification Monitor that parallel-pings every dispatched host until it confirms a reboot (down-then-up) or times out. v1.4.0 adds an optional (default ON) User Consent Prompt: an Accept/Decline dialog is shown on the logged-on user's desktop (via a one-shot interactive scheduled task) before each restart; no response within the window or no user logged on proceeds, Decline skips the host this run. The choice is read back over WinRM (no shared storage) and surfaced in the live grid + CSV. v1.5.x adds Schedule-as-Windows-Task unattended arming, rolling/go-fast mode, pre-flight ping + server-skip gates, an in-app delayed start, and a reboot-verification overhaul: the monitor opens at dispatch start, and unconfirmed hosts get a WinRM LastBootUpTime check that definitively verifies (or refutes) each reboot.

Tools.Name: UnsupportedProductRemediator
Tools.Description: Tenable/ACAS unsupported & SEoL remediation (uninstall-only). Ingest an Unsupported / SEoL Product Summary report (PDF via pdftotext, or Tenable CSV), auto-extract the affected hosts per finding, then bulk-scan those hosts over WinRM (RunspacePool) for the matching installed product and one-click uninstall it. Proven-EOL gating: a candidate is one-click removable only when the catalog proves it end-of-life (Proven flag, e.g. Flash / perpetual Office) or its installed version is below the cutoff (MSXML < 5, .NET < 8); ambiguous family matches (.NET 8, current Firefox/Java) and DBA-owned servers (SQL/Oracle) are surfaced as disabled Review rows, never one-click removed. Per-product handlers (Microsoft 365 SaRA, Adobe Acrobat GUID-MSI with RunAsPPL guard, Store/MSI/EXE), Tanium safety block, host-class filter (workstations vs servers), dry-run default, per-host results + audit log + History, CSV export. OS findings listed read-only for handoff. Catalog: JanetLocal\UnsupportedProductCatalog.json (editable, Reload Catalog button).

Tools.Name: WindowsUpgradeTool
Tools.Description: Windows 11 feature-update deployer (bench build). Three selectable remote operations over WinRM: PIN a target release (writes HKLM WindowsUpdate TargetReleaseVersion=1 + ProductVersion + TargetReleaseVersionInfo; default 24H2), UNPIN (removes them), and INSTALL CAB (New-PSSession + Copy-Item -ToSession to C:\Temp + DISM /Online /Add-Package /Quiet /NoRestart with optional delayed reboot, e.g. the 25H2 enablement package). Set Credentials (null = current CAC session), GUI host management (type/paste/import + case-insensitive dedupe), .NET ping pre-check + RunspacePool fan-out with a live progress grid, dry-run, Cancel, CSV export. Purple+Gold theme + dark titlebar.
